what: E105 amendment A1, frozen before the claim on aifoundry3 and its first launch: E101's own session 1 tools, with the layout set by E101_GEMM, at 600 MHz

P1_rate.text: the rate at 600 MHz, zeros and random alike, within 5% of frozen for gemmc1, 15% for gemmv1, 25% for the cold gemmc16 and gemmv16. PASS or FAIL per layout and format.

P2_premium.text: S of random in gemmc1 within 15% of frozen in each format. It tells whether by-column tiles draw what the benchmark draws.

P3_int8_premium.text: int8, S(gemmc1 full) - S(res full), this session, at least 12 W: the +18 W of the benchmark comes back when the tiles fit (E101's port read +0.8 W, the benchmark +17.45 W). Below 6 W it does not. Between, PARTIAL.

P4_refusal.text: fp32 by-column random: B_800 + s_800 x c, c from the measured S as E101's relation does. At or above 88 W the a2 rule refused rightly; below it the rule refused a cell it need not have, which is reported.

P5_zeros.text: zeros / random, watts, gemmc1 within 0.05 of mm16's 0.126 / 0.138 / 0.280 per format. Above that the layout keeps a cost zeros still pay.
